generator.prompt: A Roman mail shirt (lorica hamata) of the third century AD, made entirely of small interlinked riveted iron rings: a plain hip-length shirt of mail with short mail sleeves, a round neck opening and a straight hem. Shown upright, as if hanging from invisible shoulders, front view, hollow and complete. Single isolated object for an inventory picture in a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third-century Roman world. Physically based worn materials, believable hand-made construction, strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, complete geometry from every side. No stand, display plinth, mannequin, environment, hands, people, text or logos.
